description.text: This ATV tour offers a unique experience that blends adventure and culture in the spectacular landscapes of the Sacred Valley. We begin in Cruzpata, where you will receive a brief orientation on how to ride your ATV. Along the way, you can enjoy magnificent views of snow-capped mountains, farmland, and traditional Andean communities.

The route includes a visit to the Moray archaeological complex, an ancient Inca agricultural experimental site with circular terraces, and then to the surprising Salt Mines of Maras, which have been exploited since pre-Inca times. It is the perfect alternative for those looking to discover the living history of the Andes in a fun, different, and safe way.

items: Pick-up from your hotel in Cusco and departure to the community of Cruzpata.
Safety instructions and a brief ATV practice session.
Start of the ATV ride along rural roads with beautiful panoramic views.
Arrival at the Moray archaeological complex, guided visit, and time for photos.
Continue by ATV to the Salt Mines of Maras, located on the mountainside.
Visit to the viewpoint to observe the more than 3,000 salt pools.
